What a bite does

Enormous venom dose can cause rapid respiratory paralysis despite only moderate per-mg toxicity.

Name and taxonomy. Now a species complex (4 spp., 2024); held LD50 may describe a different population.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
